title: 第一章 断江退潮
content_zh:
烟雨淋沥，好似点点思愁，细如轻丝，连绵温柔。

    深幽的回廊，偷偷爬上树梢的月光。

    脚下的青石板，路旁莿影萧飒。

    细雨终究洗刷不掉风尘，

    梦想永远只在梦乡。

    墨非夜停下脚步，所有的一切戛然而止，整个世界瞬间被撕裂，半空中洪水奔涌而出，将眼前染成彻底的红色。

    一样的梦。

    又一次从梦中惊醒，墨非夜已记不清，这是多少次被惊醒，多少次在不眠中度过漫漫长夜。他看了一眼旁边鼾声如雷的墨攻行，然后站了起来，每当这个时候，他就会练习旋极术来平复自己的心情。

    旋极术是墨家一种基本功法，它依靠身体的动作与气藏的完美配合，跳过开境过程，让体内的元气瞬间爆发。

    虽然在小筏上，也丝毫不会影响。墨非夜不断地转动身体，以此来平复紧张的心情。噩梦的长年侵扰，让睡觉成为一种奢望。

    原本平静的江面，泛起一阵微波，小筏随波微微起伏。墨非夜最初并没在意，以为是自己练习旋极术引起。

    一阵声音从远处传来，初如雷霆小动，风雨骤来，后如铁骑突袭，万马踏蹄。周围江面波涛渐涌，可小筏却依旧微漾。

    墨非夜看到水天交际处，一股巨浪直奔而来，浪愈高，声愈响，小筏虽然平稳，可旁边的江水，却是越来越激扬。

    墨攻行被吵醒后，及不耐烦的睁开双眼，还未来的急抱怨，就跳了起来，站到墨非夜旁边。

    一排巨浪悬挂在空中，掺杂着“轰轰”巨响，铺天盖地的朝小筏迎头盖下。

    巨浪之下，与他们同筏的红袍男子，懒庸庸站筏头，将嘴边酒壶又抖了几抖，确认壶中完全没酒后，随手将酒壶丢开。

    红袍男子右手顺势一抓，一股江水被捏入手中。一股磅礴力量从体内迸发出来，原本懒散的气质为之一变，在高达数十丈，横贯江面的巨浪前，气势不但未落下分毫，相反还显得更加雄武。

    红袍捏水为刀，傲立在巨浪之前，衣袂飞舞，英气卓然，手中水刀虽不过尺余，可给人的感觉，却是握住个整条叶玉江。

    迎着巨浪横空一斩，绚丽的彩虹，顺着刀锋划过的轨迹浮现出来。

    瞬间江水好似凝固了一般，一条横贯江面的黑线出现在小筏前，江水迅速地沿着黑线，朝两边分开，一条深入见底的沟壑将江水隔开。

    刚才还狂暴无比的巨浪，被拦腰斩断，一部分直接被沟壑吞噬，一部分则被斩得粉碎，变成细雨零零散散地落在江面上。

    在点点波纹中，江水恢复了火力，迅速回灌将沟壑填满。

    转眼间风和日丽，水波不兴。除了半空中的那道彩虹，巨浪没有残留半点痕迹。

    小筏继续顺流而下，朝阳穿过水雾，暖洋洋的斜照在上面，红袍手中的水刀不知何时散去，他又变成那副懒散的模样，从怀中又摸出一瓶酒，继续自顾自地喝了起来。墨攻行和墨非夜两人目瞪口呆地站在小筏上，有点不知所措，如何是好。
content_en:
The mist and rain are dripping, like a little bit of sorrow, as thin as light silk, continuous and gentle.

    In the deep corridor, the moonlight sneaks up on the treetops.

    The bluestone slabs underfoot, the shadows on the roadside are rustling.

    The drizzle cannot wash away the dust after all.

    Dreams are always only in dreams.

    Mo Feiye stopped, everything came to an abrupt end, the whole world was torn apart instantly, and floods surged out of the air, dyeing his eyes completely red.

    The same dream.

    Awakening from his dream again, Mo Feiye could no longer remember how many times he had been awakened and how many times he had spent long nights without sleep. He glanced at Mo Gongxing, who was snoring like thunder next to him, and then stood up. At this time, he would practice the spinning pole technique to calm down his mood.

    The Circular Pole Technique is a basic skill of the Mohist School. It relies on the perfect coordination of body movements and Qi reservoirs to skip the process of opening the realm and allow the vitality in the body to explode instantly.

    Even though I'm on a small raft, it won't affect me at all. Mo Feiye kept turning his body to calm his nervousness. The long-term intrusion of nightmares makes sleeping a luxury.

    A wave of microwaves appeared on the originally calm river surface, and the raft undulated slightly with the waves. Mo Feiye didn't pay attention at first, thinking it was caused by his practice of polar rotation.

    A sound came from a distance, first like a small thunder, then a sudden storm, then like a cavalry attack and thousands of horses stamping their hooves. The surrounding river was gradually swelling, but the raft was still slightly rippling.

    Mo Feiye saw where the water and the sky met, and a huge wave came straight towards him. The higher the wave, the louder the sound. Although the raft was stable, the river next to it was getting more and more violent.

    After Mo Gongxing was woken up, he opened his eyes impatiently, and before he could complain urgently, he jumped up and stood next to Mo Feiye.

    A row of huge waves hung in the air, mixed with a loud "boom", and overwhelmingly covered the raft head-on.

    Under the huge waves, the man in red robe who was on the raft with them lazily stood at the head of the raft, shook the wine bottle at his mouth a few more times, and after confirming that there was no wine in the bottle, he threw the wine bottle away.

    The man in red robe grabbed his right hand and a stream of river water was squeezed into his hand. A majestic power burst out from the body, and the original lazy temperament changed. In front of the huge waves that were tens of feet high and crossed the river, not only did his momentum not drop at all, but on the contrary, he appeared more powerful.

    The red robe pinches water into a knife and stands proudly in front of the huge waves, with flying skirts and heroic spirit. Although the water knife in his hand is no more than a foot, it gives the impression that he is holding the entire Ye Yujiang River.

    Slashing across the sky against the huge waves, a brilliant rainbow appeared along the trajectory of the blade.

    In an instant, the river seemed to have solidified. A black line across the river appeared in front of the raft. The river quickly followed the black line and separated on both sides. A deep ravine separated the river.

    The huge wave that was so violent just now was cut in half, part of it was swallowed directly by the ravine, and part of it was chopped into pieces, turning into drizzle and falling scatteredly on the river.

    In the ripples, the river regained its firepower and quickly filled up the ravines.

    In a blink of an eye, the wind became sunny and the water calmed down. Except for the rainbow in mid-air, the huge waves left no trace.

    The raft continued to flow down the river, and the morning sun passed through the mist, shining warmly on it. The water knife in Hongpao's hand disappeared at some point, and he turned into his lazy look again, took out another bottle of wine from his arms, and continued to drink by himself. Mo Gongxing and Mo Feiye stood stunned on the raft, a little at a loss as to what to do.
title_en: Chapter 1: The broken river ebbs the tide
